meaning: more; even more; to a greater extent
usage: Used to indicate an increased degree or extent
Often used to compare two situations, meaning ‘even more than before’
Commonly appears with adjectives or verbs to emphasise change

examples.sentence: 天氣凍咗，今晚會更加凍。
